title: Patch: the tier cards and KPIs read the newest win rates
sources: winrates-refresh.yml: production's windowed card figures at v0.6.13b (R3882000)
notes: The win rates of record refresh from the card statistics at v0.6.13b: 784 cards with at least 20 games over their own windows (provisional figures). The tier pools and KPIs read them from this version on (R3538000, R3538001); earlier versions keep theirs, and CN Tech and NA Tech still read each game's snapshot (R3049000).
